SourceProxy.label: Cesium3DTiles Reader
SourceProxy.name: Cesium3DTiles Reader
SourceProxy.Documentation: vtkCesium3DTilesReader is a reader for Cesium3DTiles tilesets. The output is a multiblock dataset.

StringVectorProperty.name: FileName
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: Specify file name of the Cesium3DTiles tileset to read.

IntVectorProperty.name: Level
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Level in the tree we read tiles from.

SourceProxy.label: CesiumB3DM Reader
SourceProxy.name: CesiumB3DM Reader
SourceProxy.Documentation: vtkCesium3DTilesReader is a reader for Cesium B3DM files, which are a container for GLB files. The output is a multiblock dataset.

StringVectorProperty.name: FileName
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: Specify file name of the Cesium3DTiles tileset to read.
